```cypher
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(s:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND so.order_date.year = 2024
MATCH (so)-[:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH sku, sum(sohl.qty) AS lineQty
  // First, get quantity for each SKU from order lines
MATCH (so2:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(s2:Store {country: 'CA'})
WHERE so2.status = 'completed' AND so2.order_date.year = 2024
MATCH (so2)-[sohl2:HAS_LINE]->(l2:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku2:SKU)
WHERE sku2 = sku
WITH sku, sum(sohl2.qty) AS skuQty
  // Expand bundles to get item SKUs with quantities
CALL {
  WITH sku, skuQty
  MATCH p = (sku)-[:BUNDLES*0..]->(itemSku:SKU)
  WHERE sku.is_bundle = false OR length(p) > 0
  WITH itemSku, 
       CASE 
         WHEN sku = itemSku THEN skuQty
         ELSE skuQty * reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships(p) | acc * r.qty)
       END AS bundleQty
  RETURN itemSku, sum(bundleQty) AS finalSkuQty
}
  // Map item SKUs to models
MATCH (itemSku)-[mt:MAPS_TO]->(m:Model)
WITH m, sum(finalSkuQty * mt.qty) AS modelUnits
RETURN m.model_code AS model_code
ORDER BY modelUnits DESC
LIMIT 3
```
